detailProbe.scope: One previously untested Istrian station, not all fifteen. Previously failed Split detail requests not retried.
detailProbe.limitation: Sample-array positional ind codes not decoded; tmo=24 is a September 22 sample, not current sea temperature. Retained as raw research evidence only.

temperature.licence: Croatian Open Licence per DHMZ XML documentation
temperature.timeConvention: Official display explicitly labels local time; XML terms are hourly columns, not row publication times.
temperature.limitations: Station coordinates and beach representativeness unresolved. Offshore/island Rovinj-Sv.Ivan is not Amarin beach. No bindings or temperature integration. Empty cells and dash fault values must remain missing. Public reads, undocumented quota.

wavesAndCurrents.scope: Official offshore buoy methodology, uncontrolled observations; 30-minute significant wave height and 10-minute wind at 3 m. No verified local current or beach-wave target assignment. Existing Open-Meteo remains.

storm.scope: Previously discovered DHMZ CAP source reused as a research reference. Geographic coverage/cancellation mapping remains unresolved; no repeated unsuccessful search or new binding.

algae.scope: No verified dedicated operational algae endpoint in screened IZOR/DHMZ sources. Raw sample codes not assumed algae clearance.

shoreline.method: Six weighted local normals, eight individually reviewed beach chords; directed coastline land-left/water-right. North-up local plots reviewed.
shoreline.notes: First Amarin request 429, but subsequent adjacent bounded extracts contain its exact same coast geometry; no retry or copied neighbour bearing. Borozija and Finida sampling points are seaward; independent shore geometry reviewed. Istra artificial feature unresolved.
shoreline.database: Prepared only; existing known SQL-access limitation, no REST patch workaround, no new grants/RLS/schema.

production.scheduler: Collector progress observed through source_state; direct cron metadata not verified. No manual source-check trigger, new schedule or contact message.
production.limitations: Existing stale storm publication and unavailable weekly/EA records remain distinct from advancing polling. No duplicate incident notification.

validation.npmTest: 117 passed after replacing a raw object-reference assumption with full catalogue identity preservation assertions; reviewed enrichment allowed.
validation.geometry: 128 bearings reproduced against versioned directed shoreline; local API and wind-assessment propagation checked by existing all-record tests.
validation.postgresql: Local disposable PostgreSQL: actual new SQL fills 14 and leaves 1 missing; unrelated metadata preserved; second application identical. Existing manual north=0, catalogue-reimport and type/coordinate guard checks passed.
validation.permissions: DML import only; no schema, RLS, grants or cron changes. No configured transactional production SQL connection or management token; production import not applied.
validation.browser: BiVillage operator page loaded and exposed two camera widgets. Navigation to the linked player could not complete because automatic approval review timed out. Fresh playback/FOV remain unverified; no camera integration or UI component changed.
